description: Awarding of Contracts for the Supply of Aviation Fuel to SriLankan Airlines Limited at Four (04) International Airports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited following the limited international competitive bidding method for the supply of aviation fuel to SriLankan Airlines Limited at four (04) international airports of Frankfurt, Incheon, Lahore, and Ahmedabad. Eight (08) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the relevant contracts to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
